profiles.condition_context: emitted code and its modules resolve against the target; compile-time code (staged units, macros, and the modules they import) resolves against the host. A `prim` body is emitted code and resolves against the target wherever it is reached
profiles.interface_cache: keyed by the profile that selected the entry: an interface compiled for the target is keyed by the target profile (crate::store::package_key_for folds profile_identity(target) into the key), and the host resolution writes no interface and no cache entry, because it compiles nothing
